generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Performance V-Series Optiq, sold by Cadillac as its own nameplate "OPTIQ-V" (NRCan rates it as "OPTIQ-V"; EPA as "OPTIQ AWD V SERIES"). Same 85 kWh pack as the Optiq, 519 hp dual motor. Kept as its own model per the brief; the owner could fold it into Optiq as a trim instead. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://news.gm.com/home.detail.html/Pages/news/us/en/2025/jun/0609-optiq-v.html ; https://news.gm.ca/en/home.detail.html/Pages/news/ca/en/2025/jun/0609_2026-optiq-v.html
